title: Orbital Dripstone Cannon
description: Now, who WOULDN'T want a Orbital Dripstone Cannon?
body:
_An orbital strike cannon is a highly sophisticated, large-scale redstone machine in Minecraft designed by cubicmetre to deliver massive TNT payloads to any coordinate in the world, often used for destroying bases from long distances. It functions by using Nether portal based chunk loading to suspend thousands of TNT blocks in a single, un-rendered location, which is then launched at a targeted spot._

This however? This is a dripstone cannon, not TnT! pull the rod to unleash the dripstone at your location.

- /givedriprod will grant you the rod for it!

**(THIS IS THE FIRST VERSION)**

_If you want to report issues, join the discord!_
